newsitem.title: BELARUS: Belarus 96 grain output revised down to 5.79 mln T.
newsitem.headline: Belarus 96 grain output revised down to 5.79 mln T.

text.p: Belarus has revised its 1996 net grain harvest down to 5.79 million tonnes from a previous estimate of 6.50 million tonnes, the Ministry for Statistics and Analysis said on Tuesday.
But the figure is still up on 1995's net 5.60 million tonnes.
Net wheat production in 1996 rose to 600,000 tonnes from 439,000 tonnes in 1995.
The former Soviet republic produces mainly rye for black bread, but no absolute figures for the rye crop were available.
Average grain yields in 1996 were flat from year-ago levels at 2.17 tonnes per hectare.
Agriculture Minister Vasily Leonov said in October 1996 that Belarus expected to import around 500,000 tonnes of wheat in 1996, most probably from Ukraine.
Russia traditionally imports some grains from Belarus.
